verdict.rationale: An independent TechPowerUp review states this exact part's memory type (GDDR6 at 20 Gbps), bus width (256-bit), and bandwidth (640 GB/s), plus a 64 MB Infinity Cache. However, the pack contains no first-party AMD spec sheet with these figures because the www.amd.com product page could not be crawled. The only first-party VRAM figure is a generic 'up to 48GB' for the Radeon line, not this card. Missing for 10: memory capacity for the RX 9070 XT specifically, and first-party publication of memory type, bus width, and bandwidth for this exact part.
